title: Bind OBS Output authority to one Show

claims.statement: Codex is the source-producing agent for CHG-0045 under human principal @rodrigoteamx. The 2026-08-14 directive to merge CHG-0044 and proceed authorizes this bounded successor, but does not authorize multiple simultaneous Output credentials, TLS deployment, real OBS acceptance, or automatic merge of CHG-0045.
claims.evidence: AGENTS.md and the 2026-08-14 user directive 'dale al merge y a lo que sigue'.

claims.statement: CHG-0044 merged through PR 43 at 0a3c9d6136483e97014d47e9c9886364b145a8f3 after all eight Constitution jobs succeeded at the exact signed head af04d9eb8e8fe2a0fede199c265c3d44aa14d984.
claims.evidence: GitHub PR 43, merge commit 0a3c9d6136483e97014d47e9c9886364b145a8f3, and Constitution run 31851908912 observed on 2026-08-14.

claims.statement: The current AuthService persists one instance-global Output token digest without a Show identifier, authenticateConnection grants output access without Show authority, and handleProductionSubscribe accepts that credential for Program on any caller-supplied Show identifier.
claims.evidence: server/src/auth/AuthService.ts, server/src/auth/types.ts, server/src/handlers/websocket.ts, and server/tests/unit/authHttp.test.ts at 0a3c9d6136483e97014d47e9c9886364b145a8f3.

claims.statement: The current Studio rotates the global Output token before binding it to the Show selected for the generated URL, and rotating the token does not retire an already authenticated WebSocket subscription.
claims.evidence: studio/src/views/SecurityView.vue, studio/src/production.ts, AuthService.rotateOutputToken, and setupWebSocketHandler at 0a3c9d6136483e97014d47e9c9886364b145a8f3.

claims.statement: Authenticated pixel delivery is not meaningful security evidence until the Output credential carries exact Show authority and rotation retires established delivery. The first successor must therefore close and refute the cross-Show boundary before using the real transport to demonstrate Take-to-Program rendering.
claims.evidence: Governed-discovery reorder check on 2026-08-14, SPEC-0001 AC-014 and AC-015, REQ-SEC-003, and ADR-0004 least-privilege Output authority.

claims.statement: Binding the existing single active Output credential to exactly one current Show, while revoking the unsafe legacy global credential during schema migration, is the smallest compatible authority correction and does not require a multi-credential store.
claims.evidence: The product currently exposes one instance-level rotatable Output credential and one-time URL reveal; hostile transport and migration tests are the falsification mechanisms.

claims.statement: Whether operators require multiple independently rotatable Output credentials per Show or multiple simultaneous destinations remains unknown and is intentionally deferred.
claims.evidence: SPEC-0001 requires protected Show Output behavior but does not establish credential multiplicity, destination naming, or independent lifecycle semantics.

claims.statement: Whether the browser source works in a real OBS process over production TLS, survives external proxies and network loss, or is perceptually acceptable on air remains untested by this local branded-Chrome transport proof.
claims.evidence: CHG-0045 uses the real local HTTP, WebSocket and client boundaries but intentionally excludes deployment and human capture evidence.

successCriteria.statement: The persisted local-auth successor represents one active Output credential with an exact Show identifier, digest and update time; loading the legacy global-token schema preserves the owner but revokes the unscoped credential before rewriting current state.
successCriteria.verification: Auth store migration tests inspect the current schema and prove fail-closed legacy-token handling.

successCriteria.statement: Only an authenticated Owner can rotate an Output credential for an existing, non-archived Show, and the status and one-time response expose the bound Show without exposing the stored digest.
successCriteria.verification: Auth service and HTTP tests cover valid, missing, malformed, archived, anonymous and role-denied issuance.

successCriteria.statement: An Output token authenticates to exact Show authority, may subscribe only to that Show's Program bus, and remains denied for another Show, Preview, legacy channels and mutation messages.
successCriteria.verification: Real WebSocket hostile-subscription and mutation tests.

successCriteria.statement: Rotating the Output credential closes every established Output WebSocket before it can receive later Program publication, and the prior token cannot establish a new authenticated subscription.
successCriteria.verification: WebSocket rotation tests observe policy close and rejected reconnect around a subsequent production mutation.

successCriteria.statement: The Studio chooses the Show before rotation and builds the revealed browser-source URL from the immutable Show returned with that credential, so later selection changes cannot widen the token's authority.
successCriteria.verification: Studio type-check, focused URL tests, and component behavior inspection.

successCriteria.statement: A real authenticated owner flow loads a compiled Preview while Program remains empty, an exact-Show Output client renders nothing before Take, and authenticated Take publishes the complete Program snapshot as nonblank pixels through the real production WebSocket and unmodified client renderer.
successCriteria.verification: Playwright branded-Chrome proof using createApp, setupWebSocketHandler, the real compiler target, authenticated HTTP routes, and retained PNG plus JSON evidence.

definitionOfDone.statement: CHG-0045 records authority, facts, governed-discovery reorder, migration policy, refutable transport criteria, evidence limits and deferred multiplicity before implementation.
definitionOfDone.evidence: This schema-valid change contract and deterministic governance compilation.

definitionOfDone.statement: Auth persistence, service, HTTP, WebSocket access and Studio issuance carry the same exact Show authority without placing credentials in logs, reports, screenshots or committed evidence.
definitionOfDone.evidence: Path-scoped implementation review plus hostile tests and secret scans.

definitionOfDone.statement: Automated evidence covers legacy migration, exact-Show subscription, cross-Show denial, Preview and mutation denial, immediate rotation retirement, old-token rejection, Preview isolation, Take publication and real Program pixels.
definitionOfDone.evidence: Focused unit, integration and browser proof outputs bound to non-secret hashes.

definitionOfDone.statement: Governance, licensing, formatting, lint, type-check, focused and full tests, build, dependency audit, clean installation and diff checks pass before handoff.
definitionOfDone.evidence: npm run governance:check, npm run check, npm run build, npm audit, npm ci, focused proof, Prettier and git diff --check.
